answer: The crystal register is checked at draw time, lagoon lists the eligible set, and vault seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 76 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 76 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Honest users pay that once, farms 27 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
